title: [PM seat] domain:spec · seat 3 — ⏳ vacant
body:
## ① Current PM

⏳ **vacant** since 2026-10-12T05:33Z.

- **Previous occupant:** `zhuangjianguo` (`GET /user`), session `session_01KNKBCRDJCu5tGy3TEbvtrF`.
  - Seated 2026-10-09T14:32Z, stood down once (2026-10-10T11:42Z, brief `6097120702`), and re-seated 2026-10-10T15:29Z.
  - It stood down again on the maintainer's words in this session's chat: 「当前任务处理完，合并后就下班」, then, with the week's usage at 3%, 「后续如果有契约复审可以交给总监。」 and 「后续的改进也可以交接给下一pm」.
  - No claim of this seat is open. Every in-flight card was released with a `Resume-from:` line, and the hourly Routine is deleted.
- **To take the seat:** `/pm-dispatch spec@objectstack seat 3` (or `/pm-dispatch 接手`). Read this body first.
- **Charter:** `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/spec.md`.
- **Release state:** `.changeset/pre.json` is on `main` (`next`), so a breaking change is `major`. A card that only narrows is `Clause-②: no`, and it still owes a contract review before the queue.
- **Contract reviews:** by the maintainer's word above, the reviews these hand-overs owe may go to the director seat.

## ② Handover ledger

**Released at stand-down.** Each card is `pm:queue`, unassigned, and its release comment carries the next steps:

| Card | PR (draft unless noted) | State | Next | Release |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| #22340 S2 (p1, v18) | #22874, **queued** at `49ef13a518` | contract review PASS `6118257575`; pin `e5311165a8`, CI green | follow to MERGED, post-merge checks, landing note; then S3 (governed text) | `6118293260` |
| #19939 S4 (p1, v18) | #22926 at `c200819d1e` | ACCEPT `6118088551`; literals ruled B (`6117306001`) | contract review (director), green CI on a new head, queue; then the S4 pointers; S5 | `6118101711` |
| #15213 S2 | #22916 at `3059dee3f6` | ACCEPT `6117037795`; two contract-review FAILs on "editable" wording (`6117191273`, `6117921319`), swept in round 4 | contract review on the new head (director), queue; route the `_lock` fork (report Q1) before S3 | `6118375995` |
| #22848 | #22922 at `63710c5572` | contract review PASS `6118000928` | a new head (merge `main`) for a green CI run, queue | `6118114615` |
| #22870 (p2, v18) | none | maintainer-ruled `6116489638` (Q1 A, Q3 C staged, Q4 A, Q2 C3, Q5 A) | build PR 1 then PR 2 per stage-0 `6115941082` §4 | `6116716278` |
| #22161 | none | slice 12 landed (`7dbb89dc5d`) | slice 13; 91 ids over 200, listed in PR #22909's body | `6116113442` |

**CI reds that are not these PRs':**
- `Test Core`'s suite-duration ceiling step (`knowledge-ragflow`, `cloud-connection`) is red on `main` too, on hourly card #22946.
- `connector-author-shape.test.ts`'s 60 s timeout is filed as #22929.
- The fleet relay cannot re-run a job, so a green run needs a new head.

**Pointers owed at landing,** each named in its card's ACCEPT or release:
- #22585, the skill text;
- #22586, the pending changeset lines;
- objectstack-ai/objectui#12101, the designer pickers.

**Cross-lane memo** (receipt `6116174239`): two `hook.zod.ts` JSDoc clauses for the next PR that touches that file after PR #22906 lands (`6115789463`).

**Left with the maintainer:**
- #22146: `pm:awaiting-maintainer`, the G2 re-measurement.
- PR #22665 (merged): its assignee.
- **Stray files at the filesystem root,** written by this seat's devs or earlier sessions. The environment's safety check refused their removal, and no seat removes them on a dev's behalf: `/g-lean.log`, `/g-skillex.log`, `/gates.err`, `/gates.txt`, `/run-gates.out`, `/job1.pid`, `/build1.pid`, `/build-i18n.pid`, `/sa-suite.pid`, `/closure-build.pid` and `/build-base.pid`.

**Carried from earlier shifts (each also stands on its card; ⛔ none claimed):**
1. #22128's review `6053978836` ③: measure the org-axis credential case on the real route.
2. **hotcrm migration of #19939's refused spellings:** 71 sites, 20 more after pass 2, eleven structured loops after pass 4 S3, and after S4 its 19 notify nodes (one `{…}` recipient each, 35 `templateData` values and 19 links). It needs a seat that can reach `objectstack-ai/hotcrm`.
3. **Governed follow-ups for `domain:skills`** (PR #22193's review `6057753718`).

**Lessons for the next occupant:**
- The derived `pnpm check:type-check-debt` IS `--re-measure` plus an unlocked whole-workspace build. One dev ran it twice despite the dispatch. Name it NOT MEASURED in every dispatch, by its script name.
- A contract review reads every shipped sentence. #15213 S2 failed twice on one word ("editable") in texts the earlier round did not sweep. Order a `git grep` sweep of the claim's class in the first fix round.

## ③ Hot-file serial queue

⛔ Re-derive this from the live `Claim:` comments and each open PR's file list before every dispatch. `SINGLE_CLAIM_PATHS` names `.objectui-sha` only. PR #22874 moves it to `e5311165a8`, and no other PR may move it past that commit before #22874 lands.

- **`merge=os-regen` paths** (`content/docs/references/**`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/**`): use `bash scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`, then regenerate.

## ④ Notes

- **Publication:** objectstack. A merge to `main` publishes nothing. The release is the Version Packages PR, a human act.
- **Write channel:** the `fleet-write` relay (route `dispatch`), read back on every write. It has no job re-run.
- **Routine:** none. The hourly wake `trig_01S3vesBrRuPkm4z5JeFK3tT` was deleted at this stand-down.
- **Stale assignee:** `os-sam` is still on this post. Two unassign runs failed; it is not retried.
